Read the seeds you tend (`presence` (without the CLI-only `--seed-ids`) lists them). Run `terminal_run` with {"terminal": "<terminal>", "command": "make test"} (without the CLI-only `--wait --timeout 600`) and read the result, or:

```text
terminal_run {"terminal": "<terminal>", "command": "make lint"} (without the CLI-only --wait)
```
